items.name: button-04
items.title: Search Button
items.description: A rounded search button with width controls to preview its transition between a full label and an icon.

meta.prompt:
Create a 256px-wide vertical group with small outlined Expand and Collapse buttons above an outlined Search pill. Start expanded. The pill is 32px tall, fills the group width, and contains a search icon, Search text, and separate ⌘ and K keycaps.

Keep the Search accessible name in both states and hide decorative keycaps from assistive technology. The search action itself is presentational.
